headline: Recommended bonds for Nashua Public Library renovation, Pine Hill Fire Station replacement, fire training facility, and new enterprise resource planning system.
summary: The committee recommended final passage of six bond resolutions. They cover a capital equipment purchase, library renovation design, a fire training facility, a Pine Hill Fire Station replacement, fire station repairs, and an enterprise resource planning system. Each motion carried, but the minutes do not record vote counts.
decisions: Accepted communications on R-26-067, R-26-068, R-26-069, and R-26-070 and placed them on file.
Recommended final passage of R-26-064, as amended, authorizing bonds not to exceed $5,173,428 for the purchase of capital equipment. Motion carried.
Recommended final passage of R-26-067, authorizing bonds not to exceed $3,000,000 for design and ancillary costs to renovate the Nashua Public Library. Motion carried.
Recommended final passage of R-26-068, authorizing bonds not to exceed $1,500,000 for design, construction and equipping of a fire training facility. Motion carried.
Recommended final passage of R-26-069, authorizing bonds not to exceed $1,000,000 for design and ancillary costs to replace the Pine Hill Fire Station. Motion carried.
Recommended final passage of R-26-070, authorizing bonds not to exceed $1,000,000 for deferred capital maintenance of fire stations. Motion carried.
Recommended final passage of R-26-071, authorizing bonds not to exceed $9,000,000 for replacement and modernization of the city-wide enterprise resource planning (ERP) system. Motion carried.
